scopeReview.requirement: Revalidar persistencia, migración, datos, backup/restore, reconciliación y rollback cuando aplique, sin Producción.
scopeReview.reason: El flujo M11 existente ya cubre backup lógico cifrado, restore en MySQL descartable, verificación de integridad y fail-closed; no existe delta de migraciones ni scripts desde el run causal exitoso.

materialChecksFromCausalRun: full EF schema created in disposable MySQL
sentinel records and asset references seeded
encrypted backup produced with checksum/metadata and plaintext persistence rejected
restore executed into explicitly disposable local database
restored schema/migration counts and per-table row counts verified
sentinel rows and external asset references verified after restore
API started against restored database and health/readiness passed
fail-closed checks rejected Production-like backup and non-disposable restore target

backup: production-like environment or database name aborts
backup is encrypted AES256 before persistence and permissioned 0600
safe configuration allowlist excludes secret files
restore: target database name must explicitly identify restore/drill/disposable
checksum, manifest, table count, EF migration count and all table row counts are verified

integrityAndRollback.rollbackStrategy: restore only to isolated disposable target under current authorization; no DEV shared DB destructive write and no Production write
